name: War-Awoken Sword of Judgement (Weapon Skill)
effects: One single attack (11.00 each) capped at 199,999. Grants [Dark Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)], [Dark Ability DEF and RES 30% Piercing (Tactical)], [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user, grants [Dark Ability +50% Boost (Tactical)] and [Dark Ability Quick Cast (Tactical)] to user if an enemy has at least 40% imperil dark, causes [Imperil Dark 30% (15s)] to all enemies if not
